data.title: 芙兰达 · 第7学区甜品街的奶油沾鼻尖
data.description: 学园都市第7学区阳光明媚的林荫大道露天咖啡座旁，喷泉水花四溅。身穿休闲卫衣的芙兰达双手捧着巨型草莓可丽饼大咬一口，鼻尖沾上白奶油，单眼wink笑得狡黠灵动。
data.location: sunlit tree-lined shopping plaza outdoor cafe beside a decorative fountain
data.action: sitting at cafe table eating a massive strawberry crepe, cream dabbed on nose tip, winking playfully with sparkling azure eyes
data.lighting: 明丽午后日光与喷泉折射彩芒
data.promptProse: Frenda winks playfully at an outdoor cafe table clutching an overflowing strawberry crepe, a dab of white cream perched adorably on the tip of her nose.
data.animaCaption: Bright plaza sunlight sparkles on the cafe fountain as she winks with cream on her nose.
